parts:
Does unmarked include the psi / gamma parameterization (or annual occupancy / annual colonization parameterization) for the multi-season occupancy model?  Sorry if I have overlooked it.

On a related note, does unmarked include the multi-scale / multi-method occupancy model by Nichols et al. 2008?

Thank you for any help,

Mark

Kind regards  --  Marc
